common_error_server: Something went wrong on the server
common_error_session_gone: That recording is not here any more. It may have been deleted, perhaps from another device.
common_error_not_found_hint: There is nothing at this address. Your recordings and progress are all still where you left them.
common_error_generic_hint: Nothing was lost. Try again in a moment, and if it keeps happening, restarting the app usually clears it.
common_mic_unavailable: This page cannot use the microphone. Browsers only allow it on HTTPS or on localhost: open the app at the address in ORIGIN (see the README), or on the machine it runs on.
common_mic_blocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site from the icon in the address bar, then try again.
common_mic_not_found: No microphone found. Plug one in, or check the input device in Settings, then try again.
common_mic_busy: The microphone could not start. Another app (a call, a recorder) may be using it; close that and try again.
common_mic_gone: The chosen microphone is no longer available. Pick another input device in Settings.
common_confirm_delete_session: Delete this session? The recording and its pitch data will be gone. This cannot be undone.
common_confirm_discard_take: Discard this take? The recording will be lost.
